column3: MT 140:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. Close to the Hebrew; the singular “evil man… man of violence” is rendered as plural, “evil men… violent men.”
Close to the Hebrew; יָגוּרוּ (“stir up”) is rendered “gather together.”
Close to the Hebrew; “viper” is rendered “asps.”
Close to the Hebrew; “O Yahweh, O Lord” is printed “O GOD the Lord,” and “day of weaponry” “day of battle.”
Close to the Hebrew; “they will rise” is rendered “Lest they be exalted.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a man of tongue” is rendered “a slanderer,” and “in the land” “in the earth.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the poor… the needy” is rendered “the afflicted… the poor.”
